claim_ceiling: GDT806 is a transparent post-data exploratory test of twelve fixed complete-whole working rivals for six GDT805 targets across exact-local, narrow projected and disjoint global-residual context decks. Approximate deltas and ranks were visible before the adversarial gates were frozen. The related renderer decks can establish at most target-specific conditional preference or cross-denominator deck-breadth concordance. Seven repeated frames have zero decision, semantic and renderer credit. No confirmatory p-value, new role, lexeme, plaintext, component, substance, process, quality, plant, disease, cure, unit or translation may be selected.

inputs.role: transparent outcome-aware adversarial freeze and decision record
post-data deck-concordance and K12-centered comparison method
twelve zero-credit equal-width complete-whole rival signatures

question: After target-specific K12 centering, rank, LOFO, LOCO and all-opportunity correction, do fixed rivals for six complete GDT805 wholes retain a target-specific conditional preference or cross-denominator deck-breadth concordance, with exact cells and repeated frames restricted to zero-decision illustration?
title: post-data whole-context deck-concordance test
